_comment: Real triggering suite for `claude plugin eval`. Each case sends the prompt to Claude with the plugin loaded and passes when the Skill tool is called with one of the accepted skills. Regenerate the case folders with: python3 tools/make_trigger_evals.py. Run with: python3 tools/build_eval_plugin.py /tmp/eval-plugin && claude plugin eval /tmp/eval-plugin --trust-plugin --no-publish --runs 1 --ablation none
